# Nema. Uluwatu

> Nema. Uluwatu is a boutique property of 12 private studios in Pecatu, Uluwatu, Bali, Indonesia, a few minutes' walk from Thomas Beach. It combines the privacy of an exclusive retreat with the refined luxury of a boutique hotel. Guests book directly via WhatsApp; retreat facilitators can reserve the entire 12-studio property to host a private yoga, wellness or business retreat.

## Key facts
- Property type: Boutique accommodation, 12 private studios
- Address: 53JW+VRQ, Pecatu, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
- Coordinates: -8.817868, 115.097039
- Walk to Thomas Beach: a few minutes on foot
- Nearby: Uluwatu and Bingin plant-based and vegan cafes, boutique shopping, clifftop venues
- Pool: 16m communal pool with a shallow beach-style ledge
- Studios: premium queen-sized beds, high-thread-count linens, Sensatia Botanicals amenities, bespoke robes, a dedicated sunlit work nook, private outdoor bathroom with a natural mineral-enriched groundwater shower (no bathtub)
- Wi-Fi: 50mbps fiber-optic
- Security: discrete 24-hour on-site security
- Well suited to: solo travelers including solo female travelers, digital creatives and remote workers, couples, and yoga or wellness retreat facilitators
- Exclusive property reservation: the entire 12-studio property can be reserved to host a private retreat or business offsite
- Guest rating: 5 stars on Google (164 reviews)
- Languages welcomed: English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian
